check3.method: Job A: the 39 check 2 replacements were each read again on the pinned Wikipedia revision (API action=query&prop=revisions&revids=<revision>&rvslots=main, full wikitext, generic User-Agent, 8 seconds apart): claim, answer key, every distractor, no self-answer, leaks to or from the other questions of the quiz, then compared with the published, taken and draft questions. Job B: the 34 near-duplicate candidates of check 2 and the 39 replacements were compared word by word with the matched question and searched against all 2,650 published anime questions and the 792 L08 draft questions (token search script). A question is a DUPLICATE when it asks the same fact (same answer, or the same relation reversed, or the same date/year at a finer or coarser grain, or the true/false twin of a published statement); a false match on another series is KEEP. Each new question was written from a page read at a pinned revision, and searched against the same corpus and the rest of the lot before use.
